data.desc: Contango Silver & Gold is building a diversified precious metals portfolio with ambitions of becoming a mid-tier producer. Supported by cash flow from an existing producing asset, the company is advancing its gold and silver projects, including a Canadian silver project where indicated resources recently increased by 93%. Contango's longer-term production ambitions include approximately 200,000 ounces of gold and five million ounces of silver annually as it continues expanding its resource base and development pipeline.
